item.title: notes on loading states
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months loading states bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Loading states shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: what i learned about loading states
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: loading states is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Loading states shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
